About the job

Wrenfield Rail moves freight between the Manchester terminals and the ports, and the platform team owns the systems that decide which wagon goes where. We are hiring a lead PHP engineer to take the planning service, which every other system in the business asks a question of before it does anything.

The role
You would own the planning service end to end: its queue workers, its timetable imports, and the reconciliation that proves a plan matched what the yard actually did. It is a long-lived Laravel application, and most of what it does happens out of band on work that has to be safe to retry.

What you will do

  • Own the planning service, from its queue workers to the reports the yard reads each morning.
  • Take the awkward integrations: timetable feeds, terminal gate systems, and a weighbridge that answers in its own dialect.
  • Leave the reconciliation easier to reason about than you found it.
What we are looking for
  • Several years of PHP in production, including work you would still defend today.
  • Comfort with a relational database under load, and with the queries that go wrong there.
  • A habit of writing tests that describe behaviour rather than implementation.
Benefits
  • Three days a week in the Manchester office and the rest wherever suits you.
  • A training budget nobody has to justify twice.
  • Free travel on the passenger services we share track with.
